findings.issue: Filter/pagination state manages history by hand (window.history.pushState/replaceState, preventDefault on router-owned anchors) instead of using the qwik-city router (useNavigate/Link + reactive useLocation), duplicating and racing the framework's own SPA navigation.
findings.suggestion: Navigate via useNavigate()/Link and derive q/type/generation/page from useLocation(), letting the router own history; keep the loader query-independent so keystrokes stay cheap.

findings.issue: The popstate sync reads qwik's location.url.href inside a raw popstate listener; its freshness at that moment depends on qwik-city internal ordering, and stale values would leave the filters desynced since useSignal initialisers don't re-run.
findings.suggestion: Read window.location.href in the popstate handler (or drop the listener entirely by making state URL-derived).

findings.issue: Cold-cache Pokémon page fires one fetch per move of the selected game in a single Promise.all (hundreds of concurrent requests).
findings.suggestion: Chunk the fan-out (e.g. batches of 25-50) — results are cached, so only the first hit pays.

findings.issue: currentPage is clamped to totalPages but the URL retains an out-of-range ?page=, so URL and displayed page disagree on deep links.
findings.suggestion: Normalize by replacing the URL (or recompute the page param) when clamping.

findings.issue: HomeCards and PokemonCards are near-duplicates that will drift apart (they already differ in alt/hidden/type details).
findings.suggestion: One Card component with optional types/hidden props.

findings.issue: Dead typeClassName export, while type-badge class strings are hand-inlined in pokemon, moves, types routes and MoveTables.
findings.suggestion: Delete it, or actually use it everywhere to centralise the class construction.

findings.issue: Cache hidden on globalThis via (globalThis as any).__pokedexApiCache — hidden global state without need.
findings.suggestion: A module-level Map is sufficient; if dev-mode HMR duplication was the worry, comment why.

findings.issue: Pervasive any in the data layer despite well-typed output shapes; rename/refactors lose the safety net.
findings.suggestion: Introduce minimal response interfaces (Ref, NamedEntry) and type the fetch helpers on them.

summary: A solid, mostly idiomatic Qwik City app: correct use of routeLoader$, status(404), resolveValue heads, containerAttributes and fine-grained signals, with a clean server/client boundary and consistent route structure. The one real mergeability concern is the home page's hand-rolled history/popstate management, which bypasses and subtly races the qwik-city router and would need rework before I'd approve. Everything else is nits — duplicated card components, dead code, and loose typing.
